semiconductor_relevance: Medium — SPD Tech Valley provides infrastructure and facilities designed to support high-value industries, including semiconductors, but does not directly supply semiconductor products or services.
summary: SPD Tech Valley Sdn. Bhd. operates a 523-acre smart and sustainable industrial park in Malaysia, tailored for high-value industries such as semiconductors and advanced manufacturing. The park offers robust infrastructure and services to facilitate business operations for global manufacturers and technology companies.
capabilities: One-Stop Solution Centre for business setup

regional_presence.Malaysia: The company is strategically located in Negeri Sembilan, providing excellent connectivity to major transport hubs and regional markets.
